req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /<id>/update must update the post row in the database and redirect to / (302) when called by the post's author with a valid title and body. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — author submits valid title+body, expects 302 redirect to '/' and DB row updated; (2) negative NEG — non-author attempts update, expects 403; (3) boundary BVA — title is exactly one character (minimum non-empty boundary); (4) negative NEG — empty title triggers validation error, no redirect; (5) DT — unauthenticated user redirected to login; (6) STC — post row values are verified before and after update to confirm state transition. All tests use pre-loaded data: post id=2 owned by user id=1 (Rahul/stone), post id=7 owned by user id=2 (Anjali/cloud).

tests.name: test_update_post_valid_author_redirects_and_persists
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with post id=2 authored by user id=1 (Rahul)
actions: POST /2/update with title='Updated Title' and body='Updated body text'
expected: Database row for post id=2 has title='Updated Title' and body='Updated body text'
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_update_post_valid_author_redirects_and_persists():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess.clear()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body text'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        row = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 2').fetchone()
        assert row['title'] == 'Updated Title'
        assert row['body'] == 'Updated body text'

test_update_post_valid_author_redirects_and_persists()

tests.name: test_update_post_state_transition_before_and_after
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with post id=2 authored by user id=1 (Rahul) with title='Pillow delta willow'
actions: Verify initial DB state: title='Pillow delta willow', body='Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.'
POST /2/update with title='New State Title' and body='New state body'
Verify final DB state: title='New State Title', body='New state body'
expected: After update: title == 'New State Title' and body == 'New state body'
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_update_post_state_transition_before_and_after():
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        row = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 2').fetchone()
        assert row['title'] == 'Pillow delta willow'
        assert row['body'] == 'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess.clear()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'New State Title', 'body': 'New state body'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        row = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 2').fetchone()
        assert row['title'] == 'New State Title'
        assert row['body'] == 'New state body'

test_update_post_state_transition_before_and_after()
